projects.emptyTitle: Projects will be published here once the owners have approved.
projects.emptyBody: We publish a complex only when the information is verified and agreed with the owners. In the meantime, if you want to understand the options for your building, you can start with a suitability check.
projects.standfirst: Complexes where we represent and organise the apartment owners. Each project shows the information verified as of its update date.
projects.verifiedOnly: Each project shows verified information only. A missing figure does not mean nothing is happening; it means nobody has verified that figure for publication yet.

eligibility.title: Urban renewal suitability check
eligibility.heading: Let us look at the options for your building.
eligibility.standfirst: Three details are all we need to start. The rest can wait for a conversation.
eligibility.addressHint: Street and city is enough. No block or parcel number needed.
eligibility.successTitle: Thank you, we have your details.
eligibility.successBody: We will carry out an initial review and contact you about the next steps.
eligibility.successLinkIntro: In the meantime, you can read how the process works, from the first review to completion.
eligibility.aside1: We carry out an initial review of the complex.
eligibility.aside2: We contact you about the next steps.
eligibility.aside3: The check commits you to nothing.
eligibility.privacyBody: Your details come to us only. We do not pass them to developers.

ORGANISING.name: Organising
ORGANISING.description: First review, owners organising, and forming a representation.

EVALUATION.name: Evaluation and choice
EVALUATION.description: Appointing professionals, settling needs, and comparing alternatives.

PLANNING.name: Planning
PLANNING.description: Agreements, design, and progress with the municipality and planning institutions.

projectRole.heading: We organise the owners’ side of the table.
projectRole.body1: We gather the information, coordinate the professionals the owners have appointed, and bring alternatives that can actually be compared. The decisions stay with the owners.
projectRole.body2: We are not the developer and we do not carry out construction. Nor do we replace independent legal, valuation or planning advice: that comes from professionals the owners appoint, and the responsibility stays with them.

projectSections.stageIntro: The process is described in four parts. Projects do not advance in a fixed sequence: parts run in parallel and some stages repeat. This division is descriptive and carries no statutory meaning.
projectSections.timelineEyebrow: What has happened, and what is ahead
projectSections.timelineIntro: Completed milestones are recorded with the date they occurred. Milestones ahead are described without a date: they depend on things no party controls, and they are not a commitment to a date.
projectSections.factsEyebrow: What is known about the complex
projectSections.noFactsHeading: No figures have been published for this complex yet.
projectSections.noFactsBody1: Figures about this complex are published here only after they have been checked and verified. We do not publish estimates and we do not fill the gap with guesses.
projectSections.noFactsBody2: When a figure is checked and verified it will appear here with its update date. Until then what is shown is what is known: the identity of the complex, the stage the process has reached, and the milestones completed.

projectFacts.developerNote: The developer represents its own interests. It does not represent the owners, and it has no business relationship with OpenDoor Group.

verification.heading: About the information on this page
verification.checked: The figures in this section have been checked and verified by us. Last updated:
verification.absent: A figure that has not been verified does not appear here at all. A missing figure does not mean zero, and it does not mean nothing is happening.
verification.planningMayChange: Planning information can change during the process and is not a final approval.
verification.approvalsMayChange: Approvals and permits reflect the position at the date checked and can change.

projectImages.patternCaption: Schematic drawing of the complex. Not a photograph, not a rendering, and not a depiction of the proposed design.

residentBridge.heading: An apartment owner in this project?
residentBridge.body: This page carries the general information about the project and is open to everyone. Personal information, documents and running updates go to the owners in the complex directly, and are not published here.
residentBridge.comingSoon: The digital environment for owners is being built. Until it is available, information is delivered in meetings, in written summaries, and directly through the representation.
residentBridge.public2: The stage the process has reached
